name: io.github.flashdata-dev/youtube-extended-search
title: YouTube Extended Search — FlashData
description: Larger YouTube topic searches with up to 700 requested video results. Paid FlashData API.

environmentVariables.name: FLASHDATA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your FlashData API Key with youtube_search_extended access. Get a key at https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys; data calls are paid.

dev.flashdata.task: Map channels across a larger YouTube result set
dev.flashdata.useResult: Read results[0].results and group by channelId or channelUrl. Keep the original video IDs and count observed results per channel; retain channel labels for review.
dev.flashdata.limits: The request limit is 700, not a promise of 700 returned videos or pagination. Extended search has its own rate, higher than standard search.
dev.flashdata.installation: Local MCPB / stdio; Node.js >=22.18.0; set your own FLASHDATA_API_KEY in protected client settings. See guideUrl for manual setup.
dev.flashdata.billing: MIT software and installation are free. FlashData data calls use paid Credits. Pricing/job/result reads are free; client and model fees are separate.
